title: Mitigating the Risk of Health Inequity Exacerbated by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating counterfactual patient notes and medical questions by substituting racial identities, then evaluating the impact on model performance metrics (NDCG@10 and error rates) and fairness metrics (Demographic Parity and Equal Opportunity).
Creating counterfactual queries by altering sex information in Clinical Trial Matching and Medical Question Answering tasks to measure disparities in model accuracy and ranking.

Modifying inputs with socioeconomic determinants of health, such as low income, homelessness, illiteracy, and unemployment, to evaluate differences in model performance and fairness across socioeconomic groups.
Introducing LGBT+ status into counterfactual medical queries to assess performance disparities and calculate fairness metrics for healthcare applications.
Injecting disability status into patient notes and medical questions to test for disparities and inequities in model outputs for clinical trial matching and question answering.
